subject.title: hideWindow (Cmd-H) breaks prompt submission on current ChatGPT UI — prompts remain as drafts and leak into later runs; off-screen window placement works

question: Should this issue remain open until https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/302 merges, or should its unique evidence be consolidated into https://github.com/steipete/oracle/issues/298 and this duplicate closed now?
rationale: The root-cause relationship is strong, but the repository’s conservative onboarding profile does not authorize automatic issue closure, and the candidate fix still has merge-relevant delivery risk to resolve.

options.title: Keep linked until merge
options.body: Keep this issue open as additional acceptance evidence until the candidate fix lands, then close both reports against the shipped fix.

options.title: Consolidate and close now
options.body: Copy or link the off-screen workaround and accumulated-draft evidence into the canonical issue, then close this duplicate before the fix merges.

recommendation.title: Keep linked until merge
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as additional acceptance evidence until the candidate fix lands, then close both reports against the shipped fix.
